messages:
maya: Nightly longseq e2e failed the perf gate — p99 latency is +12% vs baseline on main. CI run: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/12345 :frowning:
ci-bot: Job nightly-longseq@main | FAIL | p99 = 762ms (baseline 680ms) | artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/12345
kevin: ugh. any obvious stacktrace or regression noted in the artifacts?
maya: looks like there's a bigger tail during decoding. I grabbed flamegraphs and the hot spot is in kv-cache eviction path. attaching quick screenshot in the artifact.
olga: tagging infra — @kevin did we land the kvcache eviction ordering change in the last roll? I remember a small tweak in PR #4823
kevin: yes that change landed yesterday in main. It was intended to reduce memory churn but iirc it's opt-in behind a flag for dedicated runs only.
maya: the CI run was on main without flags. failing job conf is `nightly-longseq` (no special flags) so if the code path is hit it might be a fallback case.
samir: I can bisect if we want. quick plan: rerun failing job with extra tracing, then try a binary bisect between the last green and current head. want me to take it?
maya: please, that'd be great. also want a quick repro locally — maya/kevin can you share a small cmd to reproduce the long tail? maya: try `./tools/e2e_run --suite longseq --num_iters 300 --seq_len 8192 --model ref-1b` — reproduces locally for me with similar spike.
kevin: running that locally now. if it reproduces, can we add `--kv-debug=trace` to capture eviction timestamps before rerun? samir: yes i'll start a CI bisect job if kevin confirms repro.
kevin: confirmed locally, adding kv-debug produced repeated eviction logs aligned with p99 spikes. attaching snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] kv_cache: evict shard=2 age=120ms entries=128
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] kv_cache: refill latency=42ms
```
maya: that matches the artifact heatmap. samir: starting automated bisect on the nightly pipeline now, will run compact bisect (10 runs per step) on runner pool `ci-longseq-bisect`. kicking off at commit range abcdef..HEAD. link: https://ci.redwood.ai/bisect/789
ci-bot: Bisect job submitted: https://ci.redwood.ai/bisect/789 | ETA ~45m per step
olga: if bisect points to the eviction change, we should consider a fast revert or a canary flag roll for dedicated only. maybe add an early-exit in eviction path when seq_len > 4096?
kevin: agree. if bisect points there i can push a small revert or flag guard.
maya: thanks both. samir — ping here when bisect finds a culprit and drop the failing commit hash. Also if anyone else sees this repro locally pls comment so we can correlate hardware/noise effects.
samir: will do. also offering — if bisect is noisy I can run a targeted binary search with isolated runner (no other jobs) to reduce jitter. :thumbsup:
maya: perfect. assigning follow-ups: kevin (confirm PR/flag), samir (run bisect + isolate if needed), olga (prepare a quick canary revert PR template). i'll monitor and update thread.
kevin: on it.
samir: bisect step 1 passed, step 2 running.
maya: thanks — holding on releases until we have bisect result. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
